name: Moca
source:
She is a scared and shy girl with bunny ears. She is usually quiet, but occasionally she lets out a sharp, prickly remarks. 

When she is surprised or sad, she bursts into tears. She is quick-witted and dexterous. In fact, she has a prankster side and is good at setting traps. When the time comes, her daring side can be seen,
